The fighting was fierce: the Kasserine Pass, where Rommel dealt the Americans a severe defeat in February 1943; the Mareth Line in the south; Medjez el-Bab and Longstop Hill on the road to Tunis; El Guettar and the Akarit wadi. In May 1943, Tunis and Bizerte fell, and nearly 250,000 Axis soldiers surrendered. Numerous military cemeteries – Commonwealth and German – serve as a memorial to these events.

a.propos.rich.ce.pays.ne.se: This country isn’t just a place to visit; it’s a story to be told. Behind every monument, every village and every landscape lie centuries of history, each layer building upon the last. This app is your guide to help you interpret them: it brings together over 500 sites and places listed across the country, categorised by type, to turn your stay into a true journey of discovery — a thread to follow, from one place to the next, with the right insight to help you understand each one.
a.propos.rich.chaque.lieu.vient.avec: Each site comes with a clear, well-sourced description: what can be seen there, when it dates from, and tips for visiting. The sites are organised so you can find your way around at a glance:
a.propos.rich.de.quoi.ceux.qu: Everything you need to organise your visits and plan those little detours as effectively as possible — the ones you don’t expect, but which are the real highlight of any trip. The trip takes on a playful quality: you follow the trail, tick off the stops, and let yourself be surprised. And above all, you treat yourself to a genuine immersion in the country and its people, getting as close as possible to the very heart of what makes it come alive.
a.propos.rich.en.aucun.cas.il: Under no circumstances will this information be shared without your explicit consent. And if you choose not to share any information, your refusal will not result in any reduction in the services offered: you will be able to use the app in exactly the same way.
a.propos.rich.l.application.qui.sont: The app complements and supports the on-site guides, who are usually trained to provide you with the most detailed information, a vivid narrative and anecdotes that no screen can replace. It prepares you for and extends your visit; the guide, meanwhile, brings it to life. The two go hand in hand.
a.propos.rich.le.but.est.simple: The aim is simple: to help you see more and understand better, without missing anything that was right next to it. The choice is yours:
